what_it_is: Kaggle 'Alzheimer's Dataset (4 class of Images)' (tourist55), taken from a personal GitHub mirror. The reference paper's Table B.1 calls it Alzheimer MRI; its appendix describes it as ADNI. It is not ADNI data and carries no ADNI approval.
decision: Replaces the approved-access ADNI route of decision D1 for this project, agreed by shuidisjtu with the senior colleague and the supervisor (2026-10-12).

mirror.license: none stated by the mirror; the Kaggle page lists License: Unknown (checked 2026-10-12 by shuidisjtu)

images.format: 176x208 grayscale JPEG; resized to 128x128 (LANCZOS) by the loader
images.macos_litter: each zip also holds __MACOSX entries, which the loader ignores

protocol_differs_from_pu_bench: PU-Bench's AlzheimerMRI loader treats ModerateDemented+MildDemented as positive (prior about 0.15); this project follows protocol 2.2 and the paper's tables instead

split_check.audit: read-only audit on all five seeds: roles disjoint and together the 6400 source rows; every role's array equals the source row its index names and its label is the binarised class; train-only mean/std recomputed from train match the manifest within 1e-8; test sets differ across seeds; validate_bundle passes
split_check.not_checkable: same-subject slices across roles (the source has no subject ids)

archive.verified: all 25 files of the five splits match the index; verifying against data/splits also lists the other datasets' 15 splits as unexpected, which is expected

known_risks: same-subject slices may fall on both sides of a split; the source has no subject ids, so this cannot be checked
no licence is stated by the mirror and the Kaggle page lists License as Unknown, so redistribution rights are not established
the mirror is a personal repository and may change or disappear; the commit and digests above are the pin
